author: A3_XAUUSD_IBKR_RESEARCHER
purpose: durable asset for the successor: the FOREX-NG6 TD XAU/USD daily archive may be used ONLY as archive/reference; any signal-history join to IBKR London Gold requires the mapping/basis test and representation contract drafted here.

structure_observed.values: array of {datetime: 'YYYY-MM-DD', open/high/close/low: STRINGS with up to 5 decimal places}
structure_observed.coverage_observed: 1979-12-26 through 2026-09-16 (last row is the current partial day at retrieval time)
structure_observed.calendar_caveat: rows exist for weekends and holidays (e.g. 1980-01-01, 2026-09-12 Sat, 2026-09-13 Sun) - the calendar is NOT an exchange calendar; alignment must filter to IBKR trading days
structure_observed.provenance: FOREX-NG6 run p0 staging; composite OTC gold feed (TD source), NOT IBKR London Gold

hard_rule: NO signal-history join to IBKR London Gold is permitted until ALL THREE gates below pass and their acceptance thresholds are FROZEN AT P0 (before any joined-data evaluation).

gate_1_pit_availability_test.question: when is a TD daily close finally available point-in-time?
design: TD daily close for date D is composite-feed data; establish its PIT availability lag L: the earliest time (in US/Eastern) at which the D close would have been knowable downstream

estimate L empirically only if FOREX-NG6 archived publish timestamps exist; otherwise declare L as a conservative assumption (close-of-day D + 1 business day) recorded explicitly as ASSUMED, never MEASURED
any historical join must time-stamp each TD close as available at D + L; using the D close inside day D (or before D+L) is a look-ahead violation
outputs: evidence or assumption flag per row-class

gate_2_basis_test_td_vs_ibkr.pairing: TD daily close vs IBKR London Gold daily close, aligned on IBKR trading days only (TD weekend/holiday rows excluded)
gate_2_basis_test_td_vs_ibkr.ibkr_daily_close_definition: last VALID spread sample's mid inside the declared final window of the day (rollover window 16:55-17:15 US/Eastern; use the last observation <= 17:00 ET), from the frozen probe data only
gate_2_basis_test_td_vs_ibkr.minimum_overlap: >= 20 aligned trading days within the probe collection period
metrics: basis_usd_oz = ibkr_mid_close - td_close, full distribution: mean (bias), std, min, max
abs_basis_usd_oz percentiles: p50, p90, p95, p99
daily log-return correlation TD vs IBKR over the overlap
outlier rate: fraction |basis| > candidate threshold X (X itself NOT invented here - candidate values are listed only as parameters to be frozen at P0)
gap-sign test: number of days where basis flips sign (indicating composite-vs-single-venue divergence rather than constant offset)
session-sensitivity check: IBKR close redefined from NY-PM window vs rollover window - basis stability across the two definitions

acceptance_thresholds.rule: thresholds for |basis| p50/p95/p99 (in bps), minimum return correlation, maximum outlier rate, and maximum sign-flip rate are declared as metric NAMES here; their NUMERIC values must be frozen at P0 before any joined-data use. No numbers are invented in this draft because no overlap data exists yet and outcome-blindness forbids pre-tuning to any downstream use.

gate_2_basis_test_td_vs_ibkr.additional_check: any basis drift over the overlap (regress |basis| on date) - a trending basis forbids constant-offset representation

clauses: TD composite is NOT IBKR London Gold: no history row may be relabeled as IBKR London Gold; every joined dataset carries a source column and passes the frozen basis test
permitted uses of TD history: long-horizon context (regime descriptions, vol estimation for ex-ante thresholds), NEVER broker-cost modeling (spreads, fees, slippage are IBKR-probe-only)

any signal computed on TD history and evaluated on IBKR data must apply the frozen basis representation (constant-bps offset and/or regime-conditional basis) declared at P0, PLUS the frozen 2.0 stress multiplier on any spread term
look-ahead guard: TD close for D is usable only at D + pit_lag_L (gate 1)
calendar guard: only IBKR trading days are joinable; TD weekend/holiday rows are structurally excluded
provenance guard: joins must reference this archive by sha256 49c2684ebb045302acf0c452b5aa9a3b96dff73eb3bc6f5add1801d6817fb33d; if the file changes, the basis test must be re-run
gate_3_representation_contract.preferred_default: IBKR-probe-data-only for all cost and signal evaluation; TD archive used only where its long history is irreplaceable and gates 1-3 are documented as passed

successor_checklist: 1. re-hash the TD archive; abort if sha256 differs
2. run gate 1 (PIT lag) and record measured-or-assumed status
3. freeze numeric acceptance thresholds BEFORE running any joined evaluation
4. run gate 2 on >= 20 aligned trading days of frozen probe data
5. only then draft the representation contract instantiation for the specific join
6. record everything under the probe evidence tree with hashes
